hits.title: Syngenta Group Appoints Hengde Qin as Chief Executive Officer | Syngenta Group
hits.snippet: - Succession from COO follows deliberate Board process, Jeff Rowe to remain CEO through August 1 Syngenta Group today announced that its Board of Directors has unanimously appointed Hengde Qin as Chief Executive Officer, effective August 1, 2026, following a thorough nomination and succession process. Qin, currently Chief Operating Officer and Head of Seeds, succeeds Jeff Rowe, who will remain in the role through August 1 before returning to the United States after nearly 10 years with the company.

I begin serving as CEO of Syngenta Group today. As I do, I find myself thinking not about boardrooms, but about the small farming village where I grew up. That is where I saw firsthand the resilience, determination and hard work of farming families. What I learned there continues to shape how I see the world and my belief in the importance of agriculture in strengthening food security. A growing population, climate pressures and finite natural resources mean the world must produce more food, more sustainably. Helping farmers meet that challenge is why Syngenta Group exists. I feel fortunate to lead a company with deep Swiss roots, an international outlook, world-class science, and exceptional people. Yet what makes Syngenta Group truly special is our shared purpose: breakthroughs for farmers, in every field. I will lead with humility, openness and a willingness to listen.
